<function name="GetZ" parent="CNavArea" type="classfunc">
	<description>Returns the elevation of this Nav Area at the given position.</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="pos" type="Vector">The position to get the elevation from, the z value from this position is ignored and only the X and Y values are used to this task.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="number">The elevation.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
